description: Companion to root DESIGN.md: source-grounded metadata, preview-only tonal ramps, elevation, motion, responsive boundaries, and scoped interactive component snippets for Threadline.
title: Design System: Threadline

implementationNotes: DESIGN.md intentionally begins with the required Markdown file-purpose comment. Normative primitives are recorded under canonical Markdown sections; optional YAML frontmatter is omitted.
Tonal ramps are synthesized OKLCH panel previews at fixed hue/chroma and are not shipped theme palettes; browser gamut mapping may apply. Canonical values retain owning CSS hex values.
Component CSS inherits live custom properties with literal fallbacks. Snippets describe the default semantic primitives, while specialized artwork and theme selector overrides remain in owning CSS.
Menu snippets preview material and state CSS; complete keyboard navigation, dismissal, focus return and viewport positioning require the shipped TaskActionsPopover runtime.
The current navigation side marker and stage/time grouping side lines are semantic incumbent devices, not decorative card borders or defects to normalize.
Timer station fixed-font details and business-specific diagram/artwork values are not promoted into reusable system tokens; no unrelated drift is repaired.

Appearance theme/font option descriptions, font labels and numeric samples, plus settings action-row small descriptions, inherit the owning control ink (color: inherit). Existing type size, weight and spacing carry hierarchy so selected/focus/pressed backgrounds retain readable descendant text. Settings rows retain caption size; this scoped descendant treatment does not replace semantic secondary text across all pages.

Sidebar current pages use aria-current=page. Sidebar-only is-active also covers the mobile More aggregate selection; this selected background remains stable under hover. Focus-visible and active still follow the shared later state priority. Do not generalize is-active to time-ring previews.

Annotation selection mode, highlighter and eraser expose actual aria-pressed tool state. Color-menu disclosure remains aria-expanded and mutually exclusive colors remain aria-checked; these are independent semantics.

Expired task-timer extension-trigger small text uses text-primary at rest, while the existing primary background stays a 14% timer-color/surface mix. Clock and icon timer-ink remain accent-derived. This is a scoped foreground fix in task-timers.css, not a new or changed global color token.

narrative.northStar: Apple 应用交互 · 方案 A / P1
narrative.overview:
Threadline 的工作界面以安静的内容表面、明确的文字层级和克制的背景反馈承载高密度任务。用户已指定 Apple 应用按钮和 P1 弹出菜单作为交互参照；这里记录已落地的 Web、iPhone PWA 与 Electron 共用系统，不另造品牌隐喻，也不将这些 Web 像素值解释为 Apple 官方要求。

四套主题保留各自配色与既有美术：默认蓝色、安妮雅粉色、皮卡小屋和皮卡经典。主题、深浅色与字体是独立选择。统一的是状态含义、输入可达性与菜单行为；小屋的像素材质、经典的页签和现有插画无需改造成同一种外观。
keyCharacteristics: 背景先表达反馈；键盘焦点增加内部底线，普通模式不用外围焦点环。
主操作、危险操作和中性操作共享状态顺序，各自保留可读的前景。
菜单靠近触发器，柔和半透明，动作、互斥选择与复杂表单各用相应语义。
桌面保持紧凑，手机扩大真实命中目标，极小计时站通过滚动保留可达性。

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: 主题映射语义颜色，不能另建一套 hover、pressed、selected 或键盘焦点逻辑。

rules.name: The Independent Font Rule
rules.body: 新界面继承 `font-sans`，不通过主题选择覆盖用户字体；手机可编辑控件遵循 `mobile-form-control-font-size: max(1rem, var(--text-body-size))`，不降回桌面紧凑标签字号。

rules.name: The Functional Layer Rule
rules.body: 统一菜单使用 `blur(20px) saturate(1.15)` 和 menu-shadow；复杂表单只共享适合的材质，不因此套用动作菜单键盘模型。

rules.name: The Focus Before Reset Rule
rules.body: 先给可见控件建立背景、内部底线或编辑边界，再移除普通外围轮廓；原生隐藏输入必须把反馈传给用户能看到的元素。

dos: **Do** 从语义 CSS 变量取得表面、文字与状态颜色，并检查四主题深浅色。
**Do** 保留主题和字体的独立选择，以及经典、小屋已有的美术资产与语义侧标记。
**Do** 区分持续选择、菜单展开和短暂按下，使用相应的真实 ARIA 状态。
**Do** 复用最后加载的状态系统，并为键盘提供背景、内部底线或编辑边界反馈。
**Do** 扩大真实触屏目标、保留菜单视口避让，并尊重减少动画与强制色偏好。
donts: **Don't** 恢复普通外围焦点环、点击后发光、按下缩放或状态引起的布局跳动。
**Don't** 用 hover 冒充 selected，或让固定深色填色继承不适合它的深色前景。
**Don't** 把复杂表单和确认强制包装成动作菜单，或仅用 CSS 忙碌样式阻止重复提交。
**Don't** 给新页面添加重复眉题、无必要提示文案，或将既有单页特例推广为全局装饰。
**Don't** 把像素主题原生材质一律清除，或把其硬偏移阴影复制到其它主题。
